name: Statements
title: Statements

legal_basis.note: Affidavits shall be confined to facts the deponent can of his own knowledge prove, except on interlocutory applications where belief may be stated with the grounds
A pleading verified by affidavit must distinguish what is true to knowledge from what is on information and belief

statutory_reference: Civil Procedure Code, 1908 - Order XIX Rule 3, Order VI Rule 15
authoring_note: Each statement should be a separate numbered paragraph confined to one fact. Order XIX Rule 3 limits an affidavit to facts within the deponent's own knowledge, except on an interlocutory application, where a statement of belief is allowed provided the grounds are given. A deponent who swears to matters they cannot know exposes themselves, and the affidavit is liable to be rejected.
